en: The image shows the back side of a vintage postcard. There is handwriting in French, a printed address, and a postage stamp with a postmark. The text includes an address written in English (to Russia, USSR), and the French text appears personal. Additionally, there is some Cyrillic typing, and the publisher information indicates an art series related to the Kharkov Provincial Gallery.
